narrNote: KYARR is confirmed as NARR's Kentucky state affiliate and approved certifying organization on NARR's official affiliate profile (fetched and verified). KYARR's own site, kyarr.org, returned HTTP 404 at both the root and www host on 2026-10-22, so NARR's official profile is the verified link. Note the naming overlap: Kentucky regulation 908 KAR 1:410 names the 'Kentucky Recovery Housing Network' as the NARR-recognized affiliate organization, and NARR's profile page carries that title while its text names the Kentucky Alliance of Recovery Residences.
notes: Agency is Kentucky's SAMHSA Single State Agency (DBHDID within CHFS); department page fetched and verified; phone is DBHDID's main number as published by CHFS. Crisis/help: the KY HELP Statewide Call Center (833-859-4357, staffed by Operation UNITE) is documented on the fetched official ky.gov recovery-resources page, alongside FindHelpNowKY treatment openings; after-hours, the page lists the Kentucky Opioid Assistance and Resource Hotline (800-854-6813). Kentucky 211: United Way of Kentucky is the PSC-designated statewide 211 lead agency (PSC Administrative Case No. 343; dial 2-1-1 or text ZIP to 898-211, all 120 counties) — UWKY's homepage was fetched and verified, but its dedicated 211 program page could not be fetched in-run due to research-tool rate limiting, making this the weakest content match in the state file. Medicaid: the verified CHFS Behavioral Health Innovations page documents Kentucky Medicaid's TEAMKY Section 1115 demonstration, including the SUD component and Recovery Residence Support Services, approved through December 31, 2029. Regional services run through 14 regional MHID boards / Community Mental Health Centers (verified county lookup). Voices of Hope is a Lexington-based peer-run recovery community organization serving roughly 25 counties plus detention-center and hospital programs statewide — included as Kentucky's flagship peer/RCO entry, not a statewide membership association.
